decision_conditions: <p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:</p><ul><li>Proposed Plans and Elevations (drawing no.: 24/046/006, dated: 20/03/2025)</li><li>Site Location and Block Plan (drawing no.: 24/046/004, dated: 20/03/2025)</li></ul><p>Other documents:</p><ul><li><span style="background-color: rgb(200, 228, 248);">&nbsp;Planning Statement (March 2025)</span></li><li><span style="background-color: rgb(200, 228, 248);">Pre Filter Specification (received:&nbsp; 03/04/2025)</span></li><li>Acoustica CP03 Silencer Specification<span style="background-color: rgb(200, 228, 248);">(received:&nbsp; 03/04/2025)</span></li><li>AV Mount and Cowl Specification&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="background-color: rgb(200, 228, 248);">(received:&nbsp; 03/04/2025)</span></li><li>Baffle Filter Specification&nbsp;<span style="background-color: rgb(200, 228, 248);">(received:&nbsp; 03/04/2025)</span></li><li>Box Fan Unit Specification&nbsp;<span style="background-color: rgb(200, 228, 248);">(received:&nbsp; 03/04/2025)</span></li><li>Carbon Filter Specification&nbsp;<span style="background-color: rgb(200, 228, 248);">(received:&nbsp; 03/04/2025)</span></li><li>Commissioning and Operating and Maintenance Manual&nbsp;<span style="background-color: rgb(200, 228, 248);">(received:&nbsp; 03/04/2025)</span></li><li>OC2 Guide&nbsp;<span style="background-color: rgb(200, 228, 248);">(received:&nbsp; 03/04/2025)</span></li><li>Ozone Dispersion Specification&nbsp;<span style="background-color: rgb(200, 228, 248);">(received:&nbsp; 03/04/2025)</span></li></ul><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>
The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Prior to the commencement of the development, a scheme for
the extraction and treatment of fumes and odours generated from cooking on the
premises shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority (LPA).  Any equipment, plant or process approved pursuant to such
details shall be installed prior to the first use of the premises and shall be
operated and retained in accordance with the approved details and operated in
accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. The scheme shall be installed in
accordance with the requirements detailed in EMAQ Control of Noise and Odour
from Commerciale Kitchen Exhaust Systems: 2018.

Prior to the commencement of the development, a noise scheme
for the mechanical services plant, including kitchen extraction, must be
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This plan
shall demonstrate compliance with the prescribed noise design requirements.
Once approved, the scheme must be fully implemented and thereafter maintained
as stipulated a. The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of
noise emitted from the mechanical services plant to which the application
refers, shall be lower than the existing background noise level by 10dB at all
times when the plant is in operation. Measurements shall be made at a height of
1.2 – 1.5 metres above the adjacent ground level and at least 3.5 metres from
any sound reflecting surfaces other than theground or 1 metre from the facade of the nearest first floor
(or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance with the latest British
Standard BS4142:2014. The measurement value shall be adjusted to remove the
additional sound energy contribution from reflected surfaces other than from
the ground. An alternative position for assessment /measurement may be used to
allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation
calculations detailed to show how the design criteria is achieved.  b. At all times the plant shall be isolated so as to ensure
that vibration amplitudes which causes re-radiated noise do not to exceed the
limits detailed in table 4 detailed in section 7.7.2 of BS8233:2014 “Guidance
on sound insulation and noise reduction for buildings or the plant shall be
supported on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to reduce the
structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjoining
premises. These shall be maintained thereafter. c. A commissioning acoustic test and report shall be
undertaken within 7 days of mechanical services commissioning to demonstrate
that conditions a) and b) above have been achieved. The results of the test
shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA.
